items.summary: A Polish man with far-right views drove into a busy central square in Krakow on Saturday and opened fire, killing six people and injuring 15 others before police shot and wounded him, authorities said.

items.title: 1 person killed in Etobicoke shooting, at least 2 suspects sought
items.summary: Toronto police are investigating after a male victim was killed in a shooting in Etobicoke on Saturday afternoon.

items.title: What needs to happen for Canada to join Europe's flagship student exchange program?
items.summary: Canada is negotiating to be a part of a major European exchange program that could give Canadians more opportunities to study, work and live in Europe. But how Canada would expand its participation in Erasmus+ is complicated.
